cases.sentence: Встань и измерь ею ___, и посчитай тех, кто пришел туда на поклонение.
cases.translation: Rise, measure the altar, and count those who worship in it.
cases.explain: The direct object of измерь (measure) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Встань и измерь ею ___ Божий, жертвенник, и посчитай тех, кто пришел туда.
cases.translation: Rise, and measure the temple of God, the altar, and those who worship in it.
cases.explain: The direct object of the imperative verb измерь (measure) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Язычники будут топтать святой ___ сорок два месяца.
cases.translation: The nations will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb топтать (tread) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я дам моим двум свидетелям ___, и они будут пророчествовать.
cases.translation: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy.
cases.explain: The direct object of дам (give) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Из рта этих свидетелей выходит огонь и поглощает их ___.
cases.translation: Fire comes out of their mouths and devours their enemies.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb поглощает (devours) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Им дана власть затворить ___, чтобы на землю не шел дождь.
cases.translation: They have power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain.
cases.explain: The direct object of затворить (shut up) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Десятая часть ___ разрушилась во время землетрясения.
cases.translation: A tenth of the city fell during the earthquake.
cases.explain: After part (часть), the genitive case indicates 'part of something'.

cases.sentence: Во время землетрясения погибло семь тысяч ___, остальных охватил ужас.
cases.translation: Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified.
cases.explain: After a numeral expressing thousands, the genitive case is used.

reading.ru: Мне была дана трость, наподобие посоха, и сказано, встань и измерь ею храм Божий, жертвенник, и посчитай тех, кто пришел туда на поклонение.
reading.question: What was John told to do with the reed?
options: Measure the temple of God, the altar, and count those who worship there
Write on it the words of prophecy
Show it as a sign to the nations
reading.correct: Measure the temple of God, the altar, and count those who worship there
reading.explain: The text states 'встань и измерь ею храм Божий, жертвенник, и посчитай тех' — he was told to measure the temple and count those there.

reading.ru: Я дам моим двум свидетелям силу, и они будут пророчествовать 1260 дней, одетые в рубище.
reading.question: How long would the two witnesses prophesy and what would they wear?
options: Three and a half years and white robes
reading.explain: The text says 'они будут пророчествовать 1260 дней, одетые в рубище' — they would prophesy 1260 days clothed in sackcloth.

reading.ru: Это две маслины и два светильника, стоящие перед Господом земли.
reading.question: What are the two witnesses compared to?
options: Two olive trees and two lamp stands standing before the Lord of the earth
Two stars shining in the heavens
Two prophets speaking to the nations
reading.correct: Two olive trees and two lamp stands standing before the Lord of the earth
reading.explain: The text states 'Это две маслины и два светильника, стоящие перед Господом земли' — they are the two olive trees and two lamp stands.

reading.ru: Если кто-то пытается причинить им вред, то изо рта этих свидетелей выходит огонь и поглощает их врагов.
reading.question: What happens to anyone who tries to harm the witnesses?
options: Fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies
They are protected by an invisible shield
Angels come down to defend them
The earth opens and swallows their enemies
reading.correct: Fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies
reading.explain: The text says 'изо рта этих свидетелей выходит огонь и поглощает их врагов' — fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies.

reading.ru: Но через три с половиной дня в них вошел дух жизни от Бога, и они встали на ноги.
reading.question: What happened to the witnesses after three and a half days?
options: The breath of life from God entered them and they stood on their feet
They were taken up to heaven in clouds
Their bodies were resurrected to eternal life
They disappeared and were seen no more
reading.correct: The breath of life from God entered them and they stood on their feet
reading.explain: The text states 'в них вошел дух жизни от Бога, и они встали на ноги' — the breath of life entered them and they stood on their feet.

reading.ru: Два свидетеля услышали с небес громкий голос «Поднимитесь сюда». Они поднялись в облаке на небеса, и их враги это видели.
reading.question: How did the two witnesses leave the earth?
options: They heard a voice from heaven and ascended in a cloud to heaven, and their enemies saw them
They were taken by angels to the temple
They walked through the city gates in triumph
They were transformed and disappeared in light
reading.correct: They heard a voice from heaven and ascended in a cloud to heaven, and their enemies saw them
reading.explain: The text says 'Они поднялись в облаке на небеса, и их враги это видели' — they ascended in a cloud to heaven and their enemies saw them.
